note: Re-verified against the APS programme catalogue on 2026-09-08. Grades 9-12 confirmed, and the senior capstone places students as interns, consultants or independent researchers. Held at needs_review because the programme itself is a course of study rather than a placement, and the owner should decide whether the embedded senior capstone internship belongs on the site.

offerings.summary: A project-based programme of study at the Arlington Career Center in which seniors complete a year-long capstone employed as an intern, a consultant or an independent researcher.
